column3: NASB adds “with Him” and renders “exhort” as “urge”; it ends the verse with a dash.
The quotation is in capitals; “time of favor” is rendered “THE ACCEPTABLE TIME.” Stray spacing around the quotation marks appears in the NASB text.
NASB renders “placing an obstacle” as “giving no cause for offense” and “be blemished” as “be … discredited.”
NASB renders “riots” as “tumults,” “watchings” as “sleeplessness,” and “fastings” as “hunger.”
NASB renders “being disciplined” as “punished” and “being killed” as “put to death.”
NASB moves “always” and renders “enriching many” as “making many rich.”
NASB renders “has been opened” as “has spoken freely” and “has been expanded” as “is opened wide.”
NASB renders “recompense” as “exchange” and adds “to us”; the aside is set off with dashes.
NASB follows the critical text (“or”); “be unequally yoked together” is rendered “be bound together.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Christ”); “what part” is rendered “what … in common.”
NASB follows the critical text (“we are”); the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders “receive” as “welcome”; part of the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders this part of the quotation without capitals, unlike the verses before it.
